tools.name: match_business
tools.description: Describe a business or a problem in plain words (English or Turkish), e.g. 'we lose track of supplier invoices and approvals'. Returns the Ninth Life Lab assistants that already run in shipped projects and fit it, what each matched on, systems mentioned, and what would be built new.

tools.name: search_catalog
tools.description: Search the Ninth Life Lab catalog of ready-made business assistants by words, e.g. 'inbox', 'stock', 'invoice'.

tools.name: get_assistant
tools.description: Full details of one catalog assistant by id (e.g. P01): the problem, what it does, who it is for, setup time, where it already runs.

tools.name: book_a_call
tools.description: How to start with Ninth Life Lab: the 30-minute call link and the four steps from first call to running software.
